hooks.name: Local Secret Scan (pre-commit)
hooks.description: Syncs auth layer, then runs local regex secret scanner on staged files. Blocks commit if secrets found.

action.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$input = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $json = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($json.toolInput.command -notmatch 'git commit') { exit 0 }; $src='backend/shared/auth_utils.py'; $dst='backend/layers/auth-layer/python/shared/auth_utils.py'; if((Test-Path $src) -and (Test-Path $dst)){if((Get-FileHash $src).Hash -ne (Get-FileHash $dst).Hash){Copy-Item $src $dst; git add $dst; Write-Host 'Auth layer synced'}}; & ./scripts/scan-secrets-local.ps1; exit $LASTEXITCODE"
